timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹219.38 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹47.93 Cr.
Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited’s Board recommended ₹2 final dividend per equity share (200% on ₹1 face value) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Vijaya Diagnostic reported Q4 FY26 results with a 26.6% YoY revenue jump to ₹219.38 Cr and EBITDA margin of 43.5%.
Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited shared the Q4-FY2026 earnings conference call audio recording link on May 08, 2026.
Shareholders approved Mr. Ravi Shankararamiah (DIN: 00180746) and Dr. Sasikala Paruchuri Kola (DIN: 00129614) as Independent Directors via postal ballot on May 09, 2026.
Vijaya Diagnostic held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 capex of ₹140-150 Cr and >40% EBITDA margin.

On its Q1FY27 earnings call on 7 August 2026, Vijaya Diagnostic guided FY27 revenue growth at high double digit and EBITDA margin above 40%, with capex of ₹190-195 Cr for 9 new hubs, 10-12 spokes and a Panjagutta reference lab.
